title: Classification of binary forms fixed by a nonzero translation
statement: Let N,n∈ℕ with N≠0, let T=(1 1;0 1)∈SL₂(ℤ), and let A∈BinaryForm ℂ n satisfy binaryFormRepSL ℂ n (T^N) A=A. Then there exists α∈ℂ such that A=αX^n as a multivariate polynomial.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n (ModularGroup.T ^ N) A = A → ∃ α : ℂ, A.val = MvPolynomial.C α * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ n
